meta.note: Case-variation probe, 45 items, answering Richard Sproat's point that the main probe tests one surface shape of an inflecting paradigm. Three carrier frames put the same construction in three cases: на + accusative (the existing frame, carried over unchanged), с + genitive, к + dative. The prepositional form he named, двадцати минутах восьмого, is grammatical but does not arise in an imperative instruction to an assistant, and that is reported rather than faked with an invented sentence. Case is confounded with frame by construction, and the English half carries the same three frames as a control: English has no case, so if English is flat across the frames and Russian drops in the oblique two, the frame is not the difficulty. The from-frame uses add_event because an alarm does not start at a time; within any one frame both languages call the same tool at the same time. Cells: n_minutes (productive, 0 of 8 in the main probe), half_past (frequent fixed, 45 percent), literal (health check, digits do not inflect and must be flat). PREDICTION REGISTERED IN NOTES F60 BEFORE THE RUN. The dative of the productive form is marginal and flagged per item; see tools/make_case_probe.py.
